items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Mike Gould was sitting up there with us and he says, "Do you know that I've known 4 generations of this?"

ctx.x: I know you had a message from Mike Gould here the other day about a recording.

Yeah, well, we went to a track meet one afternoon at the Colliseum and Mike Gould was sitting up there with us and he says, "Do you know that I've known 4 generations of this?" And so my son and my grandson and I were together, and he knew my dad, see? And so that's quite odd; I didn't realize it.
